title: All it takes is 10 mindful minutes
speaker: Andy Puddicombe

sentences.en: Translator: Joseph Geni Reviewer: Morton Bast We live in an incredibly busy world.
sentences.zh: 翻译:Joseph Geni Reviewer:Morton Bast 我们生活在一个非常繁忙的世界。

sentences.en: The pace of life is often frantic, our minds are always busy, and we're always doing something.
sentences.zh: 生命的节奏经常是疯狂的, 我们的头脑总是很忙, 我们总是在做一些事情。

sentences.en: So with that in mind, I'd like you just to take a moment to think, when did you last take any time to do nothing?
sentences.zh: 所以,考虑到这一点,我希望你只是 花一点时间去思考, 你最后一次花时间做什么?

sentences.en: Just 10 minutes, undisturbed? And when I say nothing, I do mean nothing.
sentences.zh: 10分钟,没有打扰?

sentences.en: So that's no emailing, texting, no Internet, no TV, no chatting, no eating, no reading.
sentences.zh: 所以,这不是电子邮件,短信, 没有互联网,没有电视, 没有聊天,不吃,没有阅读。

sentences.en: Not even sitting there reminiscing about the past or planning for the future.
sentences.zh: 甚至没有坐在那里回忆过去或规划未来。

sentences.en: Simply doing nothing. I see a lot of very blank faces.
sentences.zh: 什么都不做,我看到很多空白的脸

sentences.en: (Laughter) You probably have to go a long way back.
sentences.zh: (笑声) 你可能得走很长的路回来。

sentences.en: And this is an extraordinary thing, right?
sentences.zh: 这是一件不寻常的事,对吧?

sentences.en: We're talking about our mind. The mind, our most valuable and precious resource, through which we experience every single moment of our life.
sentences.zh: 我们谈论的是我们的头脑,我们最宝贵和宝贵的资源, 我们通过它体验我们生活的每一个时刻。

sentences.en: The mind that we rely upon to be happy, content, emotionally stable as individuals, and at the same time, to be kind and thoughtful and considerate in our relationships with others.
sentences.zh: 我们所依赖的思想是幸福的、内容的、作为个人的情感稳定的,与此同时,在我们与他人的关系中是善良的、深思熟虑的和体贴的。

sentences.en: This is the same mind that we depend upon to be focused, creative, spontaneous, and to perform at our very best in everything that we do.
sentences.zh: 这正是我们所依赖的有重点的、创造性的、自发的以及在我们所做的一切中尽我们最大的努力。

sentences.en: And yet, we don't take any time out to look after it.
sentences.zh: 但是,我们没有花任何时间来照顾它。

sentences.en: In fact, we spend more time looking after our cars, our clothes and our hair than we -- okay, maybe not our hair, (Laughter) but you see where I'm going.
sentences.zh: 事实上,我们花更多的时间 照顾我们的汽车, 我们的衣服和我们的头发—— 好吧,也许不是我们的头发,(笑声) 但你看到我要去哪里。

sentences.en: The result, of course, is that we get stressed.
sentences.zh: 当然,结果是我们受到压力。

sentences.en: You know, the mind whizzes away like a washing machine going round and round, lots of difficult, confusing emotions, and we don't really know how to deal with that.
sentences.zh: 大脑像洗衣机一样转动, 充满了困难和困惑的情绪, 我们真的不知道如何应对。

sentences.en: And the sad fact is that we are so distracted that we're no longer present in the world in which we live.
sentences.zh: 可悲的事实是,我们如此的分心 以至于我们不再存在于我们所生活的世界上。

sentences.en: We miss out on the things that are most important to us, and the crazy thing is that everybody just assumes, that's the way life is, so we've just kind of got to get on with it.
sentences.zh: 我们错过了对我们最重要的事情, 疯狂的事情是,每个人都 假设, 这就是生活的方式, 所以我们只是有种 得到它。

sentences.en: That's really not how it has to be. So I was about 11 when I went along to my first meditation class.
sentences.zh: 所以当我去参加第一个冥想课的时候 我大概11岁了

sentences.en: And trust me, it had all the stereotypes that you can imagine, the sitting cross-legged on the floor, the incense, the herbal tea, the vegetarians, the whole deal, but my mom was going and I was intrigued, so I went along with her.
sentences.zh: 相信我,它有你所能想象的所有定型观念, 坐在地板上的交叉腿, 香料,草药茶,素食主义者, 整个交易, 但我妈妈去了,我很感兴趣, 所以我跟她一起去了。

sentences.en: I'd also seen a few kung fu movies, and secretly I kind of thought I might be able to learn how to fly, but I was very young at the time.
sentences.zh: 我还看过几部功夫电影 偷偷地想着也许能学会飞行 但我当时还很年轻

sentences.en: Now as I was there, I guess, like a lot of people, I assumed that it was just an aspirin for the mind.
sentences.zh: 现在,当我在那里,我想,像很多人一样, 我假设这只是一个阿司匹林的思维。

sentences.en: You get stressed, you do some meditation.
sentences.zh: 你压力大了 就会做一些冥想

sentences.en: I hadn't really thought that it could be sort of preventative in nature, until I was about 20, when a number of things happened in my life in quite quick succession, really serious things which just flipped my life upside down
sentences.zh: 直到我20岁, 我生命中发生了许多事情, 很快地, 发生了一些非常严重的事情, 使我的生活颠倒了。

sentences.en: and all of a sudden I was inundated with thoughts, inundated with difficult emotions that I didn't know how to cope with.
sentences.zh: 突然间,我充满了思想, 充满了困难的情绪, 我不知道怎么应付。

sentences.en: Every time I sort of pushed one down, another one would pop back up again.
sentences.zh: 每次我推倒一个, 另一个会再次出现。

sentences.en: It was a really very stressful time. I guess we all deal with stress in different ways.
sentences.zh: 那时压力很大 我想我们都用不同的方式处理压力

sentences.en: Some people will bury themselves in work, grateful for the distraction.
sentences.zh: 有些人会把自己埋在工作里 感激你的分心

sentences.en: Others will turn to their friends, their family, looking for support.
sentences.zh: 其他人会向朋友、家人求助,寻求支持。

sentences.en: Some people hit the bottle, start taking medication.
sentences.zh: 有人打了瓶子 开始服药

sentences.en: My own way of dealing with it was to become a monk.
sentences.zh: 我对付它的方法就是当和尚

sentences.en: So I quit my degree, I headed off to the Himalayas, I became a monk, and I started studying meditation.
sentences.zh: 于是我放弃了我的学位, 我前往喜马拉雅山, 我成为一个修道士, 我开始学习冥想。

sentences.en: People often ask me what I learned from that time.
sentences.zh: 人们经常问我从那时学到了什么。

sentences.en: Well, obviously it changed things. Let's face it, becoming a celibate monk is going to change a number of things.
sentences.zh: 很明显,它改变了一些事情。让我们面对它, 成为一个独身的和尚会改变一些事情。

sentences.en: But it was more than that. It taught me -- it gave me a greater appreciation, an understanding for the present moment.
sentences.zh: 但这还不止于此。它教会了我—— 它给了我更大的感激, 使我对现在有了理解。

sentences.en: By that I mean not being lost in thought, not being distracted, not being overwhelmed by difficult emotions, but instead learning how to be in the here and now,
sentences.zh: 我的意思是不要迷失在思想中, 不要分心, 不要被难以承受的情绪, 而是学习 如何在这里和现在,

sentences.en: how to be mindful, how to be present. I think the present moment is so underrated.
sentences.zh: 如何记起,如何现身,我认为现在被低估了。

sentences.en: It sounds so ordinary, and yet we spend so little time in the present moment that it's anything but ordinary.
sentences.zh: 听起来很普通,但现在我们花的时间太少了, 实在是太普通了。

sentences.en: There was a research paper that came out of Harvard, just recently, that said on average, our minds are lost in thought almost 47 percent of the time.
sentences.zh: 刚刚有一份研究论文 由哈佛大学出版 平均说,我们的思想 几乎丧失了47%的时间。

sentences.en: 47 percent. At the same time, this sort of constant mind-wandering is also a direct cause of unhappiness.
sentences.zh: 47% 同时 这种不断的心智衰竭 也是不幸福的一个直接原因

sentences.en: Now we're not here for that long anyway, but to spend almost half of our life lost in thought and potentially quite unhappy, I don't know, it just kind of seems tragic, actually,
sentences.zh: 现在,我们不是在这里 这么长的反正, 但花几乎一半 我们的生活 损失在思想和可能 相当不快乐, 我不知道,这只是 有点悲惨,其实,

sentences.en: especially when there's something we can do about it, when there's a positive, practical, achievable, scientifically proven technique which allows our mind to be more healthy, to be more mindful and less distracted.
sentences.zh: 特别是当我们可以做一些事情的时候, 当有一种积极、实用、可实现、 科学证明的技术, 使我们的心灵更健康, 更注意和减少分心。

sentences.en: And the beauty of it is that even though it need only take about 10 minutes a day, it impacts our entire life.
sentences.zh: 它的美丽之处是,即使它只需要 每天大约10分钟, 它影响我们的整个生活。

sentences.en: But we need to know how to do it. We need an exercise.
sentences.zh: 但是我们需要知道怎么做 我们需要练习

sentences.en: We need a framework to learn how to be more mindful.
sentences.zh: 我们需要一个框架来学习如何更加注意。

sentences.en: That's essentially what meditation is. It's familiarizing ourselves with the present moment.
sentences.zh: 这就是冥想的本质 它让自己熟悉现在这个时刻

sentences.en: But we also need to know how to approach it in the right way to get the best from it.
sentences.zh: 但是,我们也需要知道如何以正确的方式对待它,以便从中取得最佳结果。

sentences.en: And that's what these are for, in case you've been wondering, because most people assume that meditation is all about stopping thoughts, getting rid of emotions, somehow controlling the mind, but actually it's quite different from that.
sentences.zh: 这就是这些目的,如果你一直想, 因为大多数人认为冥想就是停止思考, 摆脱情绪, 控制思想, 但实际上与这完全不同。

sentences.en: It's more about stepping back, sort of seeing the thought clearly, witnessing it coming and going, emotions coming and going without judgment, but with a relaxed, focused mind.
sentences.zh: 更多的是关于退一步, 某种看清楚的想法, 目睹它的来来去去, 情绪来来去没有判断, 但有一个放松的, 集中的头脑。

sentences.en: So for example, right now, if I focus too much on the balls, then there's no way I can relax and talk to you at the same time.
sentences.zh: 比如说,现在,如果我把太多的注意力放在球上, 那么我就不能放松 并且同时和你说话了。

sentences.en: Equally, if I relax too much talking to you, there's no way I can focus on the balls.
sentences.zh: 同样,如果我放松太多 和你说话, 有没有办法,我可以专注于球。

sentences.en: I'm going to drop them. Now in life, and in meditation, there'll be times when the focus becomes a little bit too intense, and life starts to feel a bit like this.
sentences.zh: 我要把它们扔下。现在,在生活中,在冥想中, 有的时候,焦点变得有点太强烈了, 生命开始有这样的感觉。

sentences.en: It's a very uncomfortable way to live life, when you get this tight and stressed.
sentences.zh: 这是一种非常不舒服的生活方式, 当你得到这种紧紧和压力。

sentences.en: At other times, we might take our foot off the gas a little bit too much, and things just become a sort of little bit like this.
sentences.zh: 有时,我们可能会把脚从气体上挪开 有点过头了,事情只是变得有点像这样。

sentences.en: Of course in meditation -- (Snores) we're going to end up falling asleep.
sentences.zh: 当然是在冥想中—— (Snores),我们最后会睡着。

sentences.en: So we're looking for a balance, a focused relaxation where we can allow thoughts to come and go without all the usual involvement.
sentences.zh: 所以我们在寻找一种平衡, 一种有重点的放松, 我们可以让思想来来去去没有 所有的通常的参与。

sentences.en: Now, what usually happens when we're learning to be mindful is that we get distracted by a thought.
sentences.zh: 当我们学会注意时 通常会发生的是 我们被一个想法分心

sentences.en: Let's say this is an anxious thought. Everything's going fine, and we see the anxious thought.
sentences.zh: 假设这是一个焦急的念头 一切都很好,我们看到焦急的念头

sentences.en: "Oh, I didn't realize I was worried about that."
sentences.zh: "哦,我不知道 我担心。"

sentences.en: You go back to it, repeat it. "Oh, I am worried.
sentences.zh: "哦,我好担心"

sentences.en: I really am worried. Wow, there's so much anxiety."
sentences.zh: 我真的很担心,哇,有这么多的焦虑。"

sentences.en: And before we know it, right, we're anxious about feeling anxious.
sentences.zh: 在我们知道之前,对,我们担心感到焦虑。

sentences.en: (Laughter) You know, this is crazy. We do this all the time, even on an everyday level.
sentences.zh: (笑声)你知道,这太疯狂了。我们经常这样做,即使是在日常层面上。

sentences.en: If you think about the last time you had a wobbly tooth.
sentences.zh: 如果你想想上次你有一个摇摆的牙齿。

sentences.en: You know it's wobbly, and you know that it hurts.
sentences.zh: 你知道这很摇晃,你知道这很痛

sentences.en: But what do you do every 20, 30 seconds?
sentences.zh: 但你每20 30 秒做什么?

sentences.en: (Mumbling) It does hurt. And we reinforce the storyline, right?
sentences.zh: 确实很痛,我们加固了故事线,对吧?

sentences.en: And we just keep telling ourselves, and we do it all the time.
sentences.zh: 我们不停地告诉自己, 并且我们一直这样做。

sentences.en: And it's only in learning to watch the mind in this way that we can start to let go of those storylines and patterns of mind.
sentences.zh: 只有学会以这种方式观察思想, 我们才能开始忘记那些故事情节和思想模式。

sentences.en: But when you sit down and you watch the mind in this way, you might see many different patterns.
sentences.zh: 但是当你坐下来 以这种方式观察大脑时 你可能会看到很多不同的模式

sentences.en: You might find a mind that's really restless and -- the whole time.
sentences.zh: 你可能会发现一个非常不安的头脑... 整个时间。

sentences.en: Don't be surprised if you feel a bit agitated in your body when you sit down to do nothing and your mind feels like that.
sentences.zh: 当你坐着什么都不做时 觉得自己身体有点激动 别感到惊讶 你的思想会这样

sentences.en: You might find a mind that's very dull and boring, and it's just, almost mechanical, it just seems it's as if you're getting up, going to work, eat, sleep, get up, work.
sentences.zh: 你可能会发现一个非常无聊和无聊的头脑, 它只是,几乎机械, 它只是似乎,如果你正在起床, 去工作,吃饭,睡觉,起床,工作。

sentences.en: Or it might just be that one little nagging thought that just goes round and round your mind.
sentences.zh: 或只是一个小废话 认为,只是 环绕和环绕你的思想。

sentences.en: Well, whatever it is, meditation offers the opportunity, the potential to step back and to get a different perspective, to see that things aren't always as they appear.
sentences.zh: 不管它是什么,冥想提供了机会, 可能退一步 并获得一个不同的视角, 以看到事情并非总能出现。

sentences.en: We can't change every little thing that happens to us in life, but we can change the way that we experience it.
sentences.zh: 我们不能改变生活中发生的每件小事 但我们可以改变我们经历它的方式

sentences.en: That's the potential of meditation, of mindfulness.
sentences.zh: 这就是冥想和注意的潜力

sentences.en: You don't have to burn any incense, and you definitely don't have to sit on the floor.
sentences.zh: 你不必烧香 也不必坐在地上

sentences.en: All you need to do is to take 10 minutes out a day to step back, to familiarize yourself with the present moment so that you get to experience a greater sense of focus, calm and clarity in your life.
sentences.zh: 你要做的就是每天花10分钟时间 退后一步 熟悉现在这样你就能体验到 更专注、冷静和清晰的生活

sentences.en: Thank you very much. (Applause)
sentences.zh: 非常感谢。 （掌声）
